name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::Construct
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). The 0x1060-byte file-backed read record's constructor: the base serial record part (key, child = the file's +4 face or null, flag), then data, size, kind 0 (file), error 0, the four vtables, position 0, cache start 0xffffffff, cache length 0 and the record flag byte 1. Compared whole-arena against the original over 600 worlds with and without a file.

name: cGZDBReadRecordRAM::Construct
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). The 0x58-byte memory-backed read record's constructor: the base part, kind 1 (RAM), error 0, the vtables, data = the counted block, position 0, size, an atomic +1 on the block's count, the record flag byte 1. Whole-arena compare over 600 worlds.

name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::DeletingDestructor
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 19 of the +4 face (adjustor 0x9a76c6) and slot 21 of the +0x20/+0x30 faces (0x9a76ce, 0x9a76d6) land here: base tables and member destructors, then RZMemory::Free(this) when flags&1 and not flags&4. Frees logged; flags 0..7, 0x10, 0x11; compared direct and through our +4 vtable.

name: cGZDBReadRecordRAM::DeletingDestructor
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). As the file variant plus: the counted block, when set, loses one reference and goes back to the global allocator (0x1c6c5a) at zero. Block counts 0..3 and a null block covered; frees logged.

name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::GetFieldVoid
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 27. A closed record or a read past the size raises the error (slot 63 with 1) and fails; else what the cache holds is read through the buffered read (slot 65) and the rest from the source (slot 64) at data+position, advancing position by the direct part. Three ways over 1500 worlds, each branch counted.

name: cGZDBReadRecordRAM::GetFieldVoid
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 27. Closed: false. The signed end position past the size: false. Else memcpy from the block (+4) and position moves to the end. Three ways over 1500 worlds.

name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::SetFieldVoid
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 51. Read-only: asks the access flags (twice when open), always false. The call count is compared.

name: cGZDBReadRecordRAM::SetFieldVoid
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 51. Closed: false. Signed end at or past the size: false. Else memcpy into the block (+4) and position moves to the end.

name: cGZDBRecordPackedFile::Seek
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 55 and (through adjustor 0x9afa48) +4 slot 13 for both variants: one shared body. Closed or position at or past the size: false; else the position is set. Body shared only by the two read records' tables; hooked by the family rule. Tested for both variants, direct and through each variant's own vtable.

name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::SeekRelative
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 56. Closed: false. Target (unsigned position + offset) at or past the size: false, else position = target. Wrap and edge values covered.

name: cGZDBReadRecordRAM::SeekRelative
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 56. Closed: false. Signed target negative or at or past the signed size: false, else position = target.

name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::Close
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 62. SetAccessFlags(0) and SetChild(null) on the +4 face, then position 0. Calls compared.

name: cGZDBReadRecordRAM::Close
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 62. As the file variant, then a non-null block loses one reference (freed at zero through the global allocator) and data is cleared.

name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::ReadSource
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 64. Asks the +4 face for the child by id 0x656b8f0c, calls the segment's slot 56 (read at offset) through it, raises the error on failure and releases the child. Query refused, read failed and ok cases counted.

name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::ReadBuffered
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 65. Serves the read from the 0x1000-byte cache at +0x60, refilling it from the source (slot 64) when the position is outside the window, reloading the position after the call; a failed refill marks the cache empty and raises the error. Cache windows, refills, position shifts by the source and failures covered.

name: cGZDBReadRecordPackedFile::CachedRemaining
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 66. Bytes left in the cache window from the position, 0 when the cache is empty or the position is outside it.
